⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. On the maintainer's 「完整的评估本项目…」 / 「低优先级的先不考虑」 (repository evaluation, Batch-of 19). Low priorities were excluded at filing, so the execution cards grade p2.

- **A decision card:** the options and the filer's recommendation are in the body, and the letter is the maintainer's. These are ui-merge leftovers, adjacent to the epic's #25712 (same directories). Whatever the letter, the execution waits for #25712's PR 2.

Pointer from the README / brand evaluation the maintainer asked for on 2026-10-26 (「评估 objectstack readme该如何改进」, 「objectui 是否建议去掉」, then 「同意，派卡处理」) · written 2026-10-26T13:07Z · `session_01FMuBZmssbfQkVrKRtxNvng`. ⛔ Not a claim, not a ruling.

Item ① `ui/README.md` is more than a nested duplicate of a top-level doc: it is still Object UI's **product** README, so it carries a second brand inside this repository. Read at `main` 679fc7ce:

- Title line "The Universal Schema-Driven UI Engine"; a `license-MIT` badge and a CI badge that points at the archived repository's workflow (`objectstack-ai/objectui/workflows/CI`), which will never run again.
- A `Documentation | Quick Start | Examples | Changelog | Roadmap` nav pointing at `ui/ROADMAP.md` / `ui/CHANGELOG.md` (the same files this card lists).
- A three-product narrative — `Describe → ObjectStack / Render → Object UI / Operate → ObjectOS` — that the organisation profile and the root README no longer use (two brands, not three).
- 5 links back to `github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui` (archived; `grep -c 'github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui' ui/README.md` → 5).

Whatever letter is ruled, the UI text that survives should read as a **workspace** README rather than a product one: first sentence along the lines of "`ui/` is the view layer of ObjectStack: a schema-driven React renderer, usable on its own through `@object-ui/*`"; keep the Quick Start table, the package table and the screenshots; drop the badge row and the three-product block; links go to `ui/…` paths, not to the archived repo. `@object-ui/*` package names and the objectui.org docs site (`ui/apps/site`) stay — they name a package and a site, not a brand.

This supports **A** for item ①. The root README itself is a separate maintainer-directed card (slimming + three stale lines), filed today by this session; the organisation profile and pinned repositories are the maintainer's own action.

Brief-claimed-by: session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb · batch #398 · 2026-10-26T13:30Z

Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Presented to the maintainer in batch #398 (the docs family of the 2026-10-26 repository review) as item 4 of 5. Seat increment (re-verified on `origin/main` `cdd4eea9`; the card's own analysis is not restated):
- P1–P5 hold: `ui/` carries `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `QUICK_REFERENCE.md`, `LICENSE`, `LICENSE-THIRD-PARTY.md`, `lychee.toml`, `turbo.objectui.json`; `ui/.claude/hooks/` 8 files; `ui/docs/adr/` 11 files from 0001; `ui/.github/dependabot.yml` exists and the root `dependabot.yml` has no `directory: /ui`. The only reader of `turbo.objectui.json` / `ui/lychee.toml` on main is `scripts/ui-import/README.md` (prose), so both can go once that README is updated.
- Governed tiers for the three PRs, from the register: `ui/.claude/**` is a register row (the card reads it Tier S like root `.claude/**`; the register row's tier decides — the dispatching seat reads `GOVERNED_SURFACES` before landing); `.github/dependabot.yml` is not `.github/workflows/**`, so not governed; the ADR index prefix rides #26076's PR (Tier H).
- Serialization is real: #25712 (open, `pm:dispatched`, epic) owns `ui/AGENTS.md` and the nested workflows; this card's docs fold and hook deletion wait for its PR 2 and re-read its file list first, as the card says.
- Facets read: same direction; the seat agrees with **A** (fold the six docs, keep `ui/LICENSE*`, delete the never-run `ui/.claude/hooks`, register `ui/docs/adr` under a `ui-` prefix without renaming, delete the three dead config files). Workload: devx + skills · 3 PRs · precedent #25880.
Prior rulings read: `ui/.claude` · `ui/docs/adr` · `dependabot` → #25880 A, #25712 scope, Prime Directive 13/14; thread: this card's triage comment.

Ruling: batch #398 item 4 · letter A · maintainer 「其他同意」 2026-10-26T13:42Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batch #398 with 「其他同意」 — every seat letter on the four cards other than #26073, whose letter is still open. Brief 6417246253. Letter **A**: fold the six `ui/` top-level documents into their root equivalents (`README`, `ROADMAP`, `CONTRIBUTING`, `QUICK_REFERENCE`; `ui/CHANGELOG.md` kept as frozen history or moved under releases; `ui/LICENSE` and `ui/LICENSE-THIRD-PARTY.md` stay — the ui packages are MIT); delete `ui/.claude/hooks/*` (never loaded; the root hooks guard every repository path per their headers); register `ui/docs/adr/` in the root index under a `ui-` prefix without renaming files (Prime Directive 13), riding #26076's index PR; delete `ui/.github/dependabot.yml` (GitHub reads only the root file), `ui/lychee.toml` and `ui/turbo.objectui.json` after `scripts/ui-import/README.md`, their only reader on `origin/main`, is updated. Not B (two CONTRIBUTINGs and two ROADMAPs would remain) and not C.

Serialization: after #25712's PR 2 lands (it owns `ui/AGENTS.md` and the nested workflows); the dispatching seat re-reads #25712's PR file lists first.

Workload of the chosen letter (card column): devx + skills · 3 PRs — docs fold (devx), `ui/.claude/hooks` deletion (the tier the `GOVERNED_SURFACES` row for `ui/.claude/**` carries; the landing seat reads the register, not this ruling), dependabot/config deletion (not `.github/workflows/**`, so not governed) with the ADR prefix on #26076's PR.

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:devx`, p2); `pm:awaiting-maintainer` removed in the same stroke. `Ruling-ref:` names this comment; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
